function.description: Read one source from the current approved Matter source set.

function.name: se_submit_candidate
function.description: Submit a source-backed memo Candidate for human Review.

function.name: ws_grep
function.description: Search text files under the session workspace for a literal or regular-expression pattern.

function.name: ws_list
function.description: List files under the session workspace (materials/ and out/), with size and sha256.

function.name: ws_read
function.description: Read a text file from the session workspace, optionally a line range. Rejects binary or over-limit files.

function.name: ws_write
function.description: Write (overwrite) a whole text file under the session workspace. Only out/ is intended for model output.

function.description: Read an immutable Artifact in this Matter by ID; offsets and limits are Unicode code points. No filesystem or network access.

function.name: se_read_source
function.description: Read one source from the current approved Matter source set.

function.name: se_submit_candidate
function.description: Submit a source-backed memo Candidate for human Review.

function.name: ws_grep
function.description: Search text files under the session workspace for a literal or regular-expression pattern.

function.name: ws_list
function.description: List files under the session workspace (materials/ and out/), with size and sha256.

function.name: ws_read
function.description: Read a text file from the session workspace, optionally a line range. Rejects binary or over-limit files.

function.name: ws_write
function.description: Write (overwrite) a whole text file under the session workspace. Only out/ is intended for model output.
